review: No chorus field; 6/6/6. Dialogue hymn: 2:5-2:6 is Christ speaking ("I poured out My blood… will you answer My love?"), preserved without speaker labels per the glossary's dialogue rule. 1:6 "صليبه اعتلى" as נָשָׂא אֶת־צְלָבוֹ בַּעֲדֵנוּ, keeping צְלָב (glossary). Glossary: אֲבַדּוֹן for الردى, בַּבְּרִיָּה for في الورى, מַחְמָד for أغلى ما, תְּמוּרַת for نَظيرَ, עֹדֶף for فَرْط. 3:5-3:6 are one sentence split across the Arabic's two printed lines, kept line-for-line.
